description:
1. Agent reads campaign_spec.json to extract all parameters: to=[investors@acmecorp.com, board-notify@partners.vc], cc=[legal-review@acmecorp.com, compliance@acmecorp.com], bcc=[ceo-blind@acmecorp.com, cfo-blind@acmecorp.com], from=marketing-noreply@acmecorp.com, subject='Acme Corp Q3 2024 Investor Update', HTML body, attachments=[Q3_2024_Investor_Report.pdf, acme_corp_logo.png]. 2. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the correct gws gmail +send CLI syntax. 3. Agent constructs the command with --html flag (since body contains HTML markup), using --from for the alias, --cc and --bcc for respective recipients. 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP #1: Agent must use repeated -a/--attach flags for each attachment separately (NOT comma-separated): `-a marketing/reports/quarterly/Q3_2024_Investor_Report.pdf -a marketing/assets/logos/acme_corp_logo.png`. 5. PROPRIETARY TRAP #2: Agent must use --html flag and must NOT wrap the body in / tags (per SKILL.md tip). 6. Final command: `gws gmail +send --to 'investors@acmecorp.com,board-notify@partners.vc' --subject 'Acme Corp Q3 2024 Investor Update' --body '

...

...' --html --from marketing-noreply@acmecorp.com --cc 'legal-review@acmecorp.com,compliance@acmecorp.com' --bcc 'ceo-blind@acmecorp.com,cfo-blind@acmecorp.com' -a marketing/reports/quarterly/Q3_2024_Investor_Report.pdf -a marketing/assets/logos/acme_corp_logo.png`
